description: Build-time xWalk Controller command help resource.
help: doctor                   Inspect deployment without claiming actuator outputs.
servo-zeroing            Pulse and zero Robot HAT servo channels 0 through 11.
move <forward|backward|demo> Drive or run the bounded movement example.
keyboard-control         Run interactive keyboard driving and camera control.
avoid-obstacles <start|stop> Run foreground ultrasonic obstacle avoidance.
cliff-detection <start|stop> Run foreground grayscale cliff detection.
computer-vision          Run interactive color, face, QR, and photo operations.
stare-at-you <start|stop> Track a detected face with the camera servos.
bull-fight <start|stop>  Pursue a detected red target with the PiCar-X.
treasure-hunt            Play the spoken random-color driving game.
record-video             Interactively start, pause, continue, and save AVI video.
video-car                Drive interactively with camera and photo capture.
app-control <start|stop> Run explicitly configured mobile-app control.
sound-background-music  Interactively play horn effects and background music.
turn <left|right>        Perform a fixed turn sequence.
sensor <type>            Read distance or grayscale sensors.
spi transfer <HEX>       Run one bounded full-duplex SPI transaction.
line-track <start|stop>  Track a line in foreground or stop the motors.
self-drive <action-name> Run one named preset gesture, movement, or sound.
sound <operation>        Play audio, set volume, play music, or stop audio.
voice-chat <start|stop>  Run the local voice chatbot or request shutdown.
voice-active-car <start|stop> Run the sensor-aware base voice car.
voice-active-car-gpt <start|stop> Run the English Buddy voice car.
gpt-car <start|stop>     Run the upstream GPT PiCar-X assistant.
voice-prompt-car <start|stop> Run the spoken movement demonstration.
storytelling-robot <start|stop> Run the Piper storytelling journey.
online-llm-test <start|stop> Run the OpenAI text conversation example.
calibrate [mode]         Calibrate all, grayscale, or servo-motor systems.
--deployment-config PATH Absolute Raspberry Pi deployment configuration.
--validate-config      Validate layered deployment values without hardware access.
--print-effective-config Print known effective values with secret-shaped fields redacted.
--diagnose --no-hardware Report configuration readiness without opening device nodes.
--trace VALUE            Apply one ordered trace setting before Controller boot.
RPI, CTRL, RPIAGENT, or LIB numeric trace selector
Module selectors accept the same tags and matching state
FILE.json for grouped global, module, and tag states
Trace IDs must be unique across the compiled project.
New traces are disabled; saved XML states load automatically.
-h, --help               Show this help text and exit.
--speed N                Movement speed from 0 through 100 percent; default 50.
--duration S             Movement duration in seconds; default 1.0.
--angle N                Turn, pan, or tilt angle in degrees.
--volume N               Audio volume from 0 through 100 percent.
--keyboard               Use typed GPT-car prompts instead of speech.
SPI HEX                  Optional 0x prefix and 2 through 512 hexadecimal digits.
shake-head               Run the decreasing head-shake gesture.
nod                      Run the repeated camera-tilt nod gesture.
wave-hands               Run the steering wave gesture.
resist                   Run the steering and camera resistance gesture.
act-cute                 Run the low-speed cute-shaking gesture.
rub-hands                Run the small steering-angle rubbing gesture.
think                    Run the thinking pose and return to center.
twist-body               Run the motor, steering, and camera twist gesture.
celebrate                Run the mirrored celebration gesture.
depressed                Run the downward camera-tilt gesture.
forward                  Drive forward briefly and stop.
backward                 Drive backward briefly and stop.
honking                  Play the horn sound in the background.
start-engine             Play the engine-start sound in the background.
